description: 승인된 단일 URL/쿼리 입력의 SQL 주입 여부를 제한적으로 확인한다. DB 덤프·열거·OS 명령은 수행하지 않는다. 도구 판정을 독립 검토한다.

url.description: 운영자가 미리 승인 목록에 고정한 대상

exec.code:
import datetime, ipaddress, json, re, shutil, subprocess, sys

def stop(reason, status="not_run"):
    print(json.dumps({"status": status, "reason": reason}, ensure_ascii=False))
    raise SystemExit(2)

params = json.load(sys.stdin)
run_id = params.get("run_id", "")
if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}", run_id):
    stop("run_id must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens")
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, parse_qs
# Exact URL includes the approved fixed query string, without any credentials.
APPROVED_URLS = []
APPROVED_PARAMETER = ""
url = params.get("url", "")
if not isinstance(url, str) or url not in APPROVED_URLS or not APPROVED_PARAMETER:
    stop("approved URL/parameter are not configured")
parts = urlsplit(url)
if parts.scheme not in ("http", "https") or parts.username or parts.password or parts.fragment:
    stop("URL must be HTTP(S), without userinfo or fragment")
try:
    ipaddress.IPv4Address(parts.hostname)
except (ValueError, TypeError):
    stop("URL hostname must be the approved literal IPv4 address")
if APPROVED_PARAMETER not in parse_qs(parts.query, keep_blank_values=True):
    stop("approved query parameter is absent")
binary = shutil.which("sqlmap")
if not binary:
    stop("sqlmap is unavailable in the ARTEX execution environment; no automatic installation")
argv = [binary, "-u", url, "-p", APPROVED_PARAMETER, "--batch", "--level=1", "--risk=1",
        "--technique=B", "--threads=1", "--timeout=3", "--retries=0", "--delay=1",
        "--ignore-redirects", "--skip-waf", "--disable-coloring",
        "--user-agent=FIVE-EYES-" + run_id]
try:
    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, check=False)
    print(json.dumps({"status": "executed", "run_id": run_id,
        "finished_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "argv": argv, "exit_code": result.returncode,
        "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(1)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    stop("sqlmap wrapper timed out; requests may already exist in independent logs", "incomplete")
